column1: # Ash Jenna confronts the party in Tolbi after Colosso.

column3:
You made it to Tolbi.
I wondered if you'd
come this far.{page_break}What have you seen
since Lamakan, Isaac?{end_wait}
You told us to watch.\nWe did. What are you\nhere to tell us?{end_wait}

The next beacon may burn.
I watched the lights
in my own world.{page_break}I think the Wise One
knew the cost.
I couldn't stop it.{end_wait}
You told us what\nyou believe. Where's\nthe proof?{end_wait}
I don't ask you to\ntrust me, Garet.\nJust keep looking.{end_wait}
You've given us\nno reason to follow you.\nWe have our own road.{end_wait}
Your hands shook after\nthe Manticore, Mia.\nWere you afraid of it?{end_wait}
My own anger.\nI told my friends.\nThey stayed with me.{end_wait}
Then hold on to them.\nThe next lighthouse\nmay not spare you.{end_wait}
You want us to watch.\nThen stop hiding\nwhat you know.{end_wait}
You said you'd help.\nDo you still mean\nto question the Wise One?{end_wait}
You refused my offer.\nBut you kept watching.\nWhat did you find?{end_wait}
